name: branch-no-match-no-default-failure
description: branch fails the step when no case matches and no default block is given
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: branch no match
proxy: optional
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- capture: "POST /login as: r"
- branch:
    from: r
    on:
      - match:
          status: 200
        do:
          - back
